text.tspan: Daggity confusingly puts what looks like an I (for independent) on
outcome variables. An outcome variable is a dependent variable; this
symbol may be half a "pause" symbol.
A "Difference" is some variable you notice is
and assume is a symptom of the same cause.
SymptomA is caused by the same undesirable cause
that lead to the defect, and may be easier to
follow back to the root cause than the primary
However, you must confirm SymptomB exists that
leads to the PrimarySymptom before labelling
SymptomA a "Symptom". DifferenceA is an example
of a red herring (caused by an unrelated
If you follow the DifferenceA chain to CauseA,
make CauseA the same in the good/bad inference
